Heard Sri Ajay Sengar, learned counsel for the applicant and Dr. S.B. Maurya, learned AGA-I for the State.

The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
0129 of 2022, under Sections 332, 353, 352, 307, 411, 504, 506, 42, 420, 379 IPC, Section 7 Criminal Law Amendment Act, 1932, 4/21 of Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation), Act, 1957 and 3(2) of The Prevention of Damage to Public Propety Act, 1984, Police Station Madhogarh,
District Jalaun during pendency of the trial.

sentences.text: FIR of the present case was lodged against the truck driver and owner of the Scorpio Car and according to the allegation when police intercepted the Scorpio Car then they tried to escape and driver of the truck rashly drove the truck with intention to kill the police officer and he ran over the truck over the police vehicles due to which, two police vehicles were damaged and both the drivers of the Scorpio Car and Truck managed to escape.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that during investigation it revealed that applicant was the truck driver and he tried to ran over his truck upon the police vehicles with intention to kill the Dilshad Khan vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42493391/

sentences.text: He further submits that applicant is although having criminal history of three cases but his criminal history has been explained in paragraph-19 to the affidavit filed in support of present application and applicant in the present matter is in jail since 25.10.2022.

Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant being truck driver tried to ran over his truck over the police vehicles with intention to kill the police officer but he could not dispute the fact that in the incident none of the police personnel sustained any injury and applicant in the present matter is in jail since 25.10.2022.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

Although, there is allegation against the applicant that he with intention to kill the police officer tried to run over his truck over the police vehicles due to which two police vehicles damaged but in the incident none sustained any injury.

Further, applicant is having criminal history of three cases but criminal history of the applicant has been explained in paragraph-19 to the affidavit filed in support of present application and in the present matter applicant is in jail since 25.10.2022.
Therefore, from the discussion made above, in view of this Court, it is a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant - Dilshad Khan be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.
